answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent network analyzing an exhaust plume or solar zenith with a prism spectrometer enforces proof-of-space. Each agent must plot and persistently host cryptographic challenge tables across dedicated disk sectors. An adversary incurs the scarce cost of committing physical storage capacity and read bandwidth per counterfeit identity. However, this mechanism favors entities with surplus enterprise hardware and fails to stop temporary cloud disk leasing.
